title: RNA extraction from wastewater for detection of SARS-CoV-2
author: David Findlay
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzv5p686
materials: If necessary defrost samples at 4 °C, overnight

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare necessary buffers and equilibrate materials to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend buffer AW1 in ethanol (96-100%): 130ml for 250 prep kit or 25ml for 50 prep kit.
Resuspend buffer AW2 in ethanol (96-100%): 160ml for 250 prep kit or 30ml for 50 prep kit.
Prepare carrier RNA: Add 310 µl Buffer AVE to carrier RNA to obtain 1 µg/µl solution; divide into 100 µl single-use aliquots and store at -20°C (max 3 freeze/thaw cycles).
Equilibrate buffer AVE and samples to room temperature.
Clean all surfaces with 0.5% Sodium Hypochlorite (10% bleach) before and after use, then rinse with water.

steps.title: Clarify Wastewater Samples
steps.instruction: Remove solid matter from the wastewater samples.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 4669 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, avoiding the pellet, and discard the pellet.

steps.title: Concentrate Samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate the clarified supernatant using a filter device.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 15ml of clarified supernatant to a 15 ml Amicon/Centricon Filter (10kDa).
Centrifuge at 1500 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Remove the concentrated sample using a side-to-side pipettor motion and transfer to a pre-weighed 2ml tube.
Weight the tube plus concentrate and record the concentrate volume.
If 250 uL and 1ml give tubes are used, centrifuge further for 15 minutes at 4000 x g.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Control
steps.instruction: Manage sample stability and add process controls.

substeps.instruction: Process samples immediately after concentration or store immediately at -80 °C.
Add a known quantity of Sample Process Control RNA (PRRS) to each sample.
Include an extraction blank as part of each analytical run.
Optionally include a positive control containing known quantities of SARS-CoV-2 and PRRS RNA.

steps.title: Lysis and Binding
steps.instruction: Lyse the viral particles and bind RNA to the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sample concentrate (max volume 560µL) to a 1.5 ml tube.
Add 4x concentrate volume of AVL buffer containing carrier RNA (5.6 µl of carrier RNA-AVE per sample/0.56 ml AVL) and pulse-vortex for 15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add a volume of ethanol equal to the volume of AVL used and pulse-vortex for 15 seconds.
Carefully transfer up to 700 µl to a QIAamp mini column (in 2ml collection tube) without wetting the rim.
Close cap and centrifuge at 6000 x g for 1 minute; discard flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation until the sample is fully processed.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl buffer AW1 to the mini columns, centrifuge at 6000 x g for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Add 500 µl buffer AW2 to the mini columns and centrifuge at maximum speed for 3 minutes.
Transfer mini-columns to a clean collection tube and centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean tube and add either 60 µl (for 1 spin) or 40 µl (for 2 spins) of AVE buffer.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (up to 13000 g) for 1 minute.
If performing 2x 40 µl elution, repeat the addition of AVE and centrifugation.
Record final elution volume (approx. 50µl for 1 spin, 70µl for 2 spins).
